name: SapODataHttpRequest
label: SAP OData HTTP Request
description: Perform HTTP requests to interact with SAP OData using existing connector and connection.

fields.name: ConnectionUrl
fields.label: Connection URL
fields.description: The base URL of the SAP OData service endpoint.

fields.name: HttpMethod
fields.label: HTTP Method
fields.description: The HTTP method to use for the request (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE).

fields.name: RequestUri
fields.label: Request URI
fields.description: The relative URI path to the OData entity or action (e.g., SalesOrder(1)).

fields.name: RequestBody
fields.label: Request Body
fields.description: The JSON payload to send in the request body (used for POST/PUT).

fields.name: BearerToken
fields.label: Bearer Token
fields.description: Bearer token for OAuth2 authentication (if required).

fields.name: Response
fields.label: Response
fields.description: The raw JSON response from the OData server.
